_about: Keepfetch is not in the App Store or Google Play. Its store listing is the browser extension in the Chrome Web Store and Edge Add-ons. Chrome Web Store limits: name 75 characters (45 recommended, from manifest.json), summary 132 (manifest description), description 16,000.

chrome_web_store.name: Keepfetch Downloader
chrome_web_store.summary: Send downloads, links, videos and audio to the Keepfetch desktop app (paired, local only).
chrome_web_store.description:
Keepfetch Downloader connects your browser to Keepfetch, the free download manager for Windows.

What it does:
- Takes over downloads by file type, so they run in Keepfetch with several connections and resume after anything
- Shows a download button on video and audio players, with the qualities the page offers
- Catches the streams a player loads (HLS and DASH) on sites the video downloader does not know
- Download all links, or only the selected ones, from the context menu
- Hold Alt to leave a download to the browser, or Insert to send any link to Keepfetch

Private by design: the extension talks only to Keepfetch on your own computer (127.0.0.1). It sends nothing to any server. Browser cookies are passed to the app only for the site you are downloading from, and only if you allow it.

You need the Keepfetch app for Windows: https://github.com/theharshchaudhary/SwiftHarryDM/releases/latest

Free and open source (MIT). It does not download DRM-protected video.
